description: The user changed a Wheel of Life: its scores as they now stand, and its answers when they are given. A new id starts a new wheel on the given day; for one already kept the day is ignored. A save without answers keeps the answers stored. Every score null and no answer with text, text being something other than spaces and blank lines, deletes a kept wheel and on a new id keeps nothing.

actual.description: The Actual score of each area, in the fixed order Health, Work, Money, Family, Love, Friends, Growth, Fun: 1 to 10, or null where there is none.

wanted.description: The Wanted score of each area, in the fixed order Health, Work, Money, Family, Love, Friends, Growth, Fun: 1 to 10, or null where there is none.

one.description: What a 1 looks like for the user in this area.

ten.description: What a 10 looks like for the user in this area.

lower.description: What makes the Actual score this number and not lower.

higher.description: What keeps the Actual score from being higher.

closer.description: What would move the Actual score one point closer to Wanted.

answers.description: The answers to the questions of each area, in the fixed order Health, Work, Money, Family, Love, Friends, Growth, Fun. An object holds only the questions answered. Left out, the answers stored stay as they are.

focus.description: Whether the user chose each area to focus on, in the fixed order Health, Work, Money, Family, Love, Friends, Growth, Fun. A save without it keeps the stored choice, as one without answers keeps the answers.

finished.description: True ends the stretch of rating, so the next change is an Undo step of its own (12, Undo): the view sends it when the sheet folds. Absent or false while the user is still rating.
